items.text:
I really want to like the game, but actually playing it is such a hassle. The UI is really bad -- and I play games like Dwarf Fortress and Space Station 13 -- and the tutorial isn't great. Most skills are super vague as to what they do, movement is annoying, and the autotask system (used so you don't have to micromanage your crewmembers) is a total crapshoot.

For a few fleeting moments between wrestling with the controls and looking things up when I couldn't figure out what they did or how they worked, I did have fun. This game has potential -- I love the idea, and I'm a fan of the developers, Blue Bottle Games. But as it is right now, it needs more time in the oven to be made more accessible.
items.text_zh:
我真的很想喜欢这款游戏，但实际上玩起来太麻烦了。UI真的很糟糕——而我玩过像《矮人要塞》和《太空站13》这样的游戏——教程也不怎么样。大多数技能的作用都超级模糊，移动很烦人，而自动任务系统（用来让你不必微观管理船员）完全是个碰运气的东西。

在挣扎于操作和查资料搞不懂某些东西是干什么的或怎么运作的之间，我确实有过几个短暂的快乐时刻。这款游戏有潜力——我喜欢这个想法，而且我是开发者Blue Bottle Games的粉丝。但就目前而言，它需要在烤箱里多待一段时间，才能变得更容易上手。
